name: FunnyPizzaLand: Unplugged
summary:
Originally planned as part of FunnyPizzaLand in 2001, this brand new content was recently realised after 24 years for the first time. Dive in again with Pedro in the middle of nowhere and explore together with him some of the most mysterious angles of PIZZALAND!

With this side story you will get with more strange creatures and beauties a compass for the world, exactly like it was intended to be back in the days! Are you ready to meet and old avversario again?
first DLC for a 2001 game!
surreal, hand crafted art world with dark atmosphere
full HD (1920 X 1080)
with possible Happy End ;)
